title: A2CN Withdrawal
description: The Section 7.6 act that terminates a session immediately with state WITHDRAWN. Either party may withdraw regardless of turn ownership. Signing is OPTIONAL — an unsigned Withdrawal is conformant and is attributed as an unsigned observation — but verifying is not: once withdrawal_signature is present it MUST be checked against the Section 7.3.1 signed act object, whose payload for a withdrawal is reason_code. round_number is REQUIRED because it is part of the common header every signed act covers; a Withdrawal that omits it cannot be signed. in_reply_to and reason_description are outside the signed scope because both are OPTIONAL, and a signed act's field set does not vary with what the sender chose to fill in. The message object stays open so vendor fields pass through.

in_reply_to.description: The message_id of the most recent message received, if any. OPTIONAL when withdrawing before any offers are exchanged, and NOT covered by withdrawal_signature (Section 7.6).

round_number.description: The round in progress when the Withdrawal is sent, which is 1 before any offer; a Withdrawal does not advance the round. REQUIRED so the common header can be rebuilt from the act's own fields (Section 7.6).

sender_verification_method.description: DID URL of the verification method used to sign this message. REQUIRED when withdrawal_signature is present (Section 7.6).

protocol_version.description: Not carried on the wire. A live act is rebuilt under its session's negotiated wire version, and a receiver refuses one that states another. A recorded act states the version it was signed under and is rebuilt under it; a recorded act that states none is rebuilt under "0.2", never under a verifier's own wire version (Section 7.3.1).

reason_code.description: Inside the signed scope: it is the substance of the withdrawal and the field a later dispute turns on (Section 7.6).

reason_description.description: Free text, OPTIONAL, and NOT covered by withdrawal_signature. Untrusted input (Section 13.7).

withdrawal_signature.description: OPTIONAL. Attached JWS Compact Serialization over base64url(ASCII(hash)) of the Section 7.3.1 signed act object. Not a JWT claim set.
